title: Choose Claude Code effort when starting a session

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-280#choose-claude-code-effort

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** SEED-280#choose-claude-code-effort, completed revision ebb1d7f6498602634868706747f0f95654bac4d7 (implementation 1c9b99fd5; no dashboard differences between the two).
- **Promise (key example 1):** If Claude Code, Opus and high are selected in a story workflow's start dialog, Start launches the session with `--effort high`.
- **Fault:** `dashboard/server/hosts/claude/launch.ts` (`launchClaude`). The `startClaudeInBackground` options changed from `effort: request.effort,` to `effort: undefined,`. The chosen effort was admitted but no longer forwarded to `claude`. The fixture and assertion were left intact.
- **Fixture:** synthetic `claude` (`dashboard.claudeScenario("launched")`, `dashboard.claudeLaunchCalls()`) through the execution dialog in `launchJourney`.
- **Maintained assertion:** `dashboard/tests/launches/agent-launch-model.spec.ts:124`, test "the execution dialog offers Claude Code's efforts whatever the model, and Opus with high starts the session with --effort high". It expects `argv.slice(at, at + 4)` to equal `["--model","opus","--effort","high"]`.
- **Scratch:** a detached worktree at `/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/e4d17f0c/tmp/ic-scratch` on ebb1d7f. It was clean before the probe (0 status entries) and set up with `setup-native npm` and `browser`. The execution checkout was not edited. Its 3 staged deletions of SEED-280 and plan 545 records belong to Wrap Up.
- **Command:** `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts dashboard/tests/launches/agent-launch-model.spec.ts -g "Opus with high starts the session with --effort high" --reporter=list`
- **Baseline:** 1 passed (the selected test ran, 3.3s).
- **Faulted run:** 1 failed, at line 124 on the intended assertion. The received argv was `["--model","opus","/dough-execute-plan SEED-B#b"]`, missing `--effort high`. This confirms that the launch happened (one call was recorded after the poll) and that the wrong behavior was on the intended path: the effort was dropped before `claude` ran.
- **Restoration:** a shell `trap` ran `git checkout -- dashboard/server/hosts/claude/launch.ts` on exit. Afterwards `git status --short` was empty (matching the pre-probe state), and the same command passed again (1 passed, 2.2s).

## Cost

- **Test runtime (measured, Playwright-reported wall time per run):** baseline 6.1s (test 3.3s), faulted 2.4s test time, restored 3.5s (test 2.2s). The total across three runs was about 12s of runner-reported time.
- **Human effort:** unavailable. No human took part in this run, and no separate measure exists.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable. No separately supported token or tool-time measure was exposed to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 55254 ms (measured), from 1794183746554 to 1794183801808 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
